changelog:
Initial release: Check Point R80+/R81.x firewall security policy audit skill.

- Performs rulebase layer analysis, including rule structure, ordering, permissiveness, and cleanup candidates.
- Audits Software Blade activation and licensing status on each gateway.
- Validates SmartConsole management plane health, SIC trust, and management server architecture.
- Reviews NAT policy, covering both automatic and manual NAT rules.
- Includes identity awareness assessment, compliance verification, and MDS (Multi-Domain Server) domain isolation checks.
- Requires only read-only access; no policy modifications performed.
